cluster_reason: MultiBackgroundInitializer coordinates and composes BackgroundInitializer instances (internal dependency MultiBackgroundInitializer -> BackgroundInitializer). These two classes form a small cohesive initializer-related cluster with many interactions between them; moving them together keeps their package-private interactions internal and minimizes the need to expose members to the remaining package.

blocks.goal: Move the BackgroundInitializer cluster (BackgroundInitializer and MultiBackgroundInitializer) into a new subpackage to reduce god component coupling.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.initializer to hold initializer-related classes.
Move BackgroundInitializer to org.apache.commons.lang3.concurrent.initializer to group initializer responsibilities and reduce package-level coupling.
Move MultiBackgroundInitializer alongside BackgroundInitializer to preserve internal composition and package-private interactions.

After moving the whole cluster to the destination package, update only the minimum required visibility in moved classes and related remaining classes so the project can compile. Do not change behavior. Do not move additional classes.
